text:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — need to finalize owners/timelines for customer comms items: status page copy, 72h customer summary, and RCA-sharing guidance. Also note recurring cache-pressure pattern across recent incidents; want that surfaced. Proposed owners: @michelle (status page), @keerthi (72h), @ben + @rebecca (RCA policy). Ack and ETA?

michelle: Ack. I can own status page. Draft suggestion below, please react with edits.

michelle: ```
We experienced degraded inference throughput for affected customers. Full service was restored at 14:07 UTC.
Impact: increased latencies and intermittent errors for a subset of requests between 12:0314:07 UTC.
Cause: cache pressure in the prefix KV cache (investigation ongoing).
What we're doing: implementing additional safeguards and monitoring to reduce recurrence risk.
Next update: a 72-hour customer summary with remediation plan will be posted by Friday.
```

keerthi: Ack. Ill draft the 72h summary. Quick question — should 72h include stack snippets or keep high-level? Need legal guidance on redaction.

legalbot: From legal: Do not include raw traces, session tokens, or internal hostnames in public-facing summaries. Enterprise customers may request more detailed artifacts under contractual/data-access paths.

ben: +1 from comms. Suggested RCA policy blurb: "We will provide a redacted RCA to all impacted customers within 72 hours. Customers with contractual data access can request the full RCA through their account team." Acceptable?

rebecca: Sounds fine. Legal, confirm redaction rules: PII, internal hostnames, raw traces, and exact token values redact?

legalbot: Confirmed. Redact PII, internal hostnames, exact stack traces, and any keys/tokens. Provide timeline, root cause summary, and mitigation steps.

jordan: Good. Timelines proposed: status page final by tomorrow EOD (michelle), 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC (keerthi), RCA policy language repo PR by end of week (ben/rebecca). Please confirm or adjust.

michelle: I can post a PR by 18:00 UTC tomorrow. Will add a short line calling out the recurring prefix-cache pattern so customers know it's being tracked.

keerthi: I will deliver the 72h draft by Fri 17:00 UTC. Will mark sensitive sections and ask legal for quick review.

ben: Rebecca and I will prepare policy language and a CSM-facing guidance note. ETA: Fri COB.

jordan: Remediation/action items (please confirm owners):
- infra: add cache-pressure alert thresholds + automated soft-eviction (owner: keerthi, ETA 2w)
- runtime: review KV cache defaults & backpressure behavior (owner: rachel, ETA 1w)
- product: analyze query patterns causing long prefixes (owner: rebecca, ETA 3w)
Add these to the incident tracker and link tasks.

rebecca: Ill add product item to tracker and tag owners.

opsbot: Created INC-4399 "Customer comms: status page + 72h summary + RCA policy" assigned to michelle/keerthi/ben, due 2026-04-11. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4399

jordan: TL;DR decisions:
- Status page final by tomorrow EOD (owner: michelle)
- 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC (owner: keerthi)
- Redacted RCA to all impacted customers; full RCA via contract channels for enterprise (owners: ben/rebecca/legal), decision logged.
- Remediation owners listed above; tasks to be added to tracker.

michelle: Posted PR: https://git.internal/statuspage/changes/678 — folks: quick review appreciated.

keerthi: Starting 72h draft now; will ping for tech review in ~2 hours.

rebecca: I'll draft the CSM guidance note and share in #customer-success once ready.

jordan: Thanks all. If you hit blockers, prefix messages with "blocker:" so we can triage quickly. :thumbsup:
